name: Yasmine Innocence
source:
You play a young man like everyone else who is looking for success after finishing his studies. He has a life like everyone else, with games, sports, films, etc.... But one day, he receives a call from his mother telling him that an old friend of hers needs his help. At first, he doesn't want to, but when he sees the pairs of asses in that house, well... play the game and you'll understand... 

[From [url=https://amaziri.itch.io/yasmine-innocence-v003-win-linux-mac-fr-en]Itchio[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演一名再普通不过的年轻人，完成学业后正在寻找出人头地的机会。他和所有人一样过着平常日子，打打游戏、做做运动、看看电影等等……直到某天，他接到母亲打来的电话，说她的一位老朋友需要他的帮忙。起初他并不情愿，可当他瞧见那栋房子里一双双迷人的翘臀时，嗯……玩过游戏你就懂了……
